name: Midara na Tsumi ~Etsuraku no Shuujitsu~
source:
Christmas Eve of 2000 AD. Everyone is sure that the Earth is going to be destroyed the next day. How will this last night pass?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-november-2001-nijuubako.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
公元2000年的平安夜。人人都坚信地球将在第二天毁灭。这最后一夜会如何度过？
